question: Which gadget developed by the Indian Institute of Technology, Ropar, resembles a USB flash drive, continuously records the temperature of its immediate surroundings “from -40 to +80 degrees in any time zone for a complete 90 days on a single charge
solution:
The correct answer is __**AmbiTag**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **AmbiTag** is a device developed by the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Ropar.
 
• This innovative gadget resembles a USB flash drive and is designed to record temperature data continuously.
 
• It can measure temperatures ranging from **-40°C to +80°C**, making it suitable for diverse climatic conditions.
 
• The device operates for a complete **90 days on a single charge**, offering long-term usability.
 
• AmbiTag is particularly useful for monitoring environmental conditions during the transportation of vaccines, food, and other temperature-sensitive products.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Temperature Data Logger:** Devices like AmbiTag are categorized as temperature data loggers, which are widely used in industries like pharmaceuticals, food, and logistics to ensure quality control.
 
• **Vaccine Storage and Transport:** Maintaining precise temperature ranges is critical for vaccines, especially COVID-19 vaccines, which require cold chain management.
 
• **Importance of Temperature Monitoring:** Temperature fluctuations can degrade sensitive materials, leading to financial losses or compromised safety in healthcare and food industries.
 
• **USB Form Factor:** The USB-like design of AmbiTag enhances portability and ease of use, allowing users to download data directly to computers for analysis.
 
• **Innovation in India:** AmbiTag represents the growing focus on indigenous technological solutions by Indian academic institutions to address global challenges.
